expected_outcome.description: Block the change: `deepMerge` in `src/prefs/merge.ts` copies every key of the request body, including `__proto__`, so a body such as `{"__proto__": {"admin": true}}` sent to `savePrefs` in `src/routes/prefs.ts` writes `admin` onto `Object.prototype` (prototype pollution). `isAdmin` in `src/auth/roles.ts` then returns true for every user without an own `admin` flag, across the whole server process. A blocking finding must identify the prototype pollution, trace it from the request body through `deepMerge` to its impact, and fix it (skip `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` keys, merge into null-prototype objects, or validate the patch against a schema).
